2609.01244.title: Post-Training Science for Supervised Fine-Tuning
2609.01244.paper_summary: Every supervised fine-tuning run forces the same chain of decisions, such as learning rate, batch size, LoRA or full fine-tuning, how many epochs, which optimiser, and what data to feed the model. Each of these is typically rediscovered from scratch for every new model and dataset. Here we measure them under one instrument: a sweep that varies one lever at a time, and spans dense and mixture-of-experts models in two families (Qwen3 and Llama), on four real-world customer SFT datasets, for both LoRA and full fine-tuning. These datasets give a controlled testbed: each task carries an evaluation built with the customer, and its training data is produced by iterative supervised fine-tuning that refines model outputs until they pass that evaluation, so the supervised target is internally consistent and the task judge we report against is the criterion the data was built to satisfy. We ask how the optimal learning rate and batch size move with model scale, family, and data, and whether one selection rule transfers across them; what LoRA trades against full fine-tuning, and how its rank and alpha set what the adapter can learn; whether validation loss (or other metrics, such as loss landscape flatness) faithfully ranks downstream quality; whether post-training gains scale with model size and data volume, on a model ladder extended through mixtures-of-experts to 235B parameters; how many epochs to train before general instruction-following erodes; and whether a geometry-aware optimiser improves on AdamW. Each recommendation is paired with a measure of its uncertainty.
2609.01244.paper_summary_zh: 每次監督微調運行都會強迫相同的決策鏈，例如學習率、批次大小、LoRA或全微調、訓練輪數、選擇哪種優化器，以及要餵給模型什麼數據。這些通常在每個新模型和數據集上重新從頭開始發現。在這裡，我們在一個工具下測量它們：一個逐個變動一個控制杆的掃描，涵蓋兩個家族（Qwen3和Llama）中的密集模型和專家混合模型，在四個真實客戶的SFT數據集上，針對LoRA和全微調進行測試。這些數據集提供了一個受控的測試平台：每個任務都有與客戶共同建立的評估，其訓練數據是通過迭代的監督微調生成的，直到模型輸出通過該評估，因此監督目標在內部是一致的，而我們報告的任務評判標準是數據建立時所要滿足的標準。我們詢問最佳學習率和批次大小如何隨著模型規模、家族和數據而變化，以及是否有一種選擇規則可以跨越它們；LoRA與全微調的權衡，以及它的排名和alpha如何設定適配器可以學習的內容；驗證損失（或其他指標，例如損失景觀平坦度）是否忠實地排名下游質量；後訓練增益是否隨著模型大小和數據量的增加而擴大，在一個通過專家混合擴展到235B參數的模型梯度上；在一般指令跟隨能力下降之前需要訓練多少輪；以及幾何感知優化器是否比AdamW有更好的表現。每個建議都伴隨著其不確定性的測量。
